notes.title: v1.2.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
General

Inflicting Poison on an already poisoned enemy will now retain the highest poison damage value.
Added a new "Saving Your Game" tutorial after the first fight in the Dew Meadows.
Improved the "Trap Gauntlet" tutorial description to inform players that traps deal increased damage on higher difficulties.

This update will not affect in-combat saves.

notes.title: v1.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
General

Winning certain battles that loot all unopened chests will now centre the camera on those chests before opening them.
Bug Fixes

Added GPU information into the log file to help catch rare crashes caused by certain GPUs.
Fixed a misplaced Dark Flame trap in the Ashguard lava room trap gauntlet.
Fixed an audio bug when moving back towards the door in the second Willow-only fight. (thanks beebee!)
Fixed a translation error for Miniature Coffin in Simplified Chinese. (thanks wspr_!)

notes.title: v1.2.0 Nightmare Update
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/iwu6F64.png

General

Added a new Nightmare difficulty level

Nightmare difficulty now replaces Hardcore difficulty.
Nightmare is substantially harder, and is meant for players who found Hard too easy.
Existing save files can switch to Nightmare difficulty in the Options menu.

Added a Standard or Hardcore game mode selection

Standard: Units will respawn after being defeated in combat.
Hardcore: Units cannot be used again after being defeated in combat (aka. perma-death).
Previous saves made on the old Hardcore difficulty will now use the new Hardcore game mode. 
Saves made on the new Hardcore mode will have a purple heart on their save file.
Standard or Hardcore modes can only be selected when making a New Game, and cannot be changed later.

Enemies

Reduced enemy difficulty in the third fight of the Dew Meadows.
Increased the chest time in the fight to the right of the town in the Dew Meadows.
Increased the chest time in the secret fight in the Coral Oasis.
Increased the chest time in the fight above the maze in the Kingdom of Grandia.
Moved a Bomb Pillow in the first Colosseum fight.

Cards

Detonate Pillow
No longer increases in damage per debuff type on the Pillow by default.
This effect has been moved to Miniature Coffin.

Cascading Frost
Increased INT scaling from 120 to 140.
Reduced Area of Effect from 3 to 2 tiles.

Fire Trap
Increased duration from 3 to 5 turns.

Ice Trap
Increased duration from 3 to 5 turns.

Equipment

Added three new items to the Tier 5 shop:

Bottled Fairy
Spiked Sallet
Mirror Shield
Check them out in-game to see what they do!


Heart Bracelet
Now applies Stim to enemies that already have Charm.
Reduced MP gained from 2 to 1.

Spotter's Scope
Increased INT and DEX scaling to 100.
Now sets Snipe to always have 5 range.

Retaliator
Now always activates when dodging an attack.
Reduced DEX scaling from 150 to 140.

Glass Platemail
Reduced HP gained from 50% to 40%.

Miniature Coffin
No longer inflicts all debuffs to adjacent enemies when detonating a Pillow.
Instead, it now provides 40% more damage per debuff type on the Pillow.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where Steam Achievements were not being awarded when launching the game without an internet connection.
Fixed a bug where enemy damage forecasting was incorrect on Easy and Medium difficulties.
Fixed a bug where Retaliator did not attack friendly units when used with Friendly Fire.
Fixed a translation error with Shadow's Blindfold in Simplified Chinese (thanks vtxtune!)

notes.title: v1.1.0 Epilogue Update
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/xfDpO5x.png

Since the launch of Dream Tactics, we've received a lot of positive and passionate feedback from our players. We set out to create the best strategy RPG we could, and we cannot express how happy it makes us to see everyone enjoying it.

That being said, we realized that one aspect of the game—the ending—did not meet the expectations of many of our players, and we wanted to address that.

In this update, we're proud to announce that we've written a new epilogue for the game, which will play after the credits roll.

Additionally, to celebrate, Dream Tactics will be on sale for 20% off from May 27th 10:00AM PDT until June 3rd 10:00AM PDT! Thank you all for your support, and we hope to continue making Dream Tactics the best it can be.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897650/Dream_Tactics/

General

Added a new epilogue cutscene after defeating Dream Eater.
Lowered the damage of the Dark Flame traps in Ashguard by 33%.
Chest completion for the Empire of Ashguard will now exclude chests that are not yet obtainable.
Barricades in the Empire of Ashguard will now be automatically removed when finishing a fight.
Minor adjustments to the wording around stat scaling.
Polished Japanese localization.

Cards

Dagger ThrowNow scales with 60 STR and DEX.ShurikenNow scales with 50 DEX and AGI.Head ShotNow gives +3% CRIT per Rose stack, instead of modifying the card's base critical hit chance.Melee (Summon Nightmare)Increased STR scaling from 80 to 100.AssassinateDecreased LUK scaling from 100 to 80.CloneDecoy now increases damage taken by 100% (from 50%).
Equipment

Lucky Star
Reduced the LUK scaling of Star Slam from 100% to 80%.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where Thermometer and Friendly Fire did not affect the damage of Reignite or Wild Fire.
Fixed a bug where teleporting the party in combat could overwrite units that were there previously.
Fixed a bug where Temporal Bracers did not apply when refreshing status effects with a 1 turn duration.
Fixed a bug where duplicate controls were present when inspecting cards while fielding units.
Fixed rounding errors in stat scaling when using Heartwood Bow.
Fixed a potential crash when using Cold Snap.
Fixed a potential crash when failing a fight.

You can join us over on Discord; we would love to hear your thoughts on our epilogue!

And if you haven’t yet, we’d greatly appreciate it if you left us an honest review on Steam. Steam reviews are incredibly important for indie games as it allows more players like yourselves to discover Dream Tactics.

notes.title: v1.0.4 Hotfix 1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Balance

 Reduced difficulty of Dream Eater, specifically:

 Lowered his final phase HP by 20%.
 Increased the stack count of Doom from 6 to 9.
 Adjusted the variety of enemies and their stats in certain phases.
 Reduced the HP scaling of one of the Coral Oasis bosses by 20%.
 Slightly reduced the difficulty of enemy spawns near the end of the Crystal Caves boss fight.
 Slightly increased enemy difficulty in the first few fights of the Dew Meadows.

Art Improvements

 Polished a variety of pillow profiles.
 Fixed collision issues on various levels that previously caused players to get stuck.
 Improved the sorting behaviour of players underneath roofs in the Crystal Caves.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a variety of crashes when loading in-combat saves.
 Fixed a crash caused by Grenade Pillow using Flashbang in certain situations.
 Fixed a crash when trying to unequip a Dream Fragment while playing the game in Japanese.
 Fixed a bug where units with Phasing could get removed from combat when traps triggered underneath them.
 Fixed a bug where the incorrect amount of EXP was being awarded.

 All existing save files will be automatically updated to the correct EXP & Level values.
 Completing all of the fights will now bring units to level 50.
 Prevented a crash when using Flint Axe or Fire-starter Suit in complex scenarios.

notes.title: Version 0.4.7 Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
New Features

Added a Map to the game! Press Select while exploring to bring it up!
Lock Save Files! You can now lock and unlock save files, to prevent accidentally overwriting them.
Coins from barrels will now automatically move towards the player.
Added Playstation and Switch controller icons.
Added a "Sell All" feature to the shop.
Players can now use the Left/Right Bumpers to cycle through enemies as well as their own playable units.
Auto Mode in story segments will now flash green while on.

Balance

Cards

Skewer: Increased STR scaling from 100 -> 110.

Equipment

Carrying Case: 

Reduced Red EP cost from 2 -> 1.
Increased starting redraws from 2 -> 3.
Carrying Case can now be found in the demo.

Some items have been renamed to follow a material system. For example, Short Sword -> Bronze Sword.

Status Effects

Carrot: Reduced LUK per stack from +20 -> +15%.

Misc

Reduced drop rate of Pillow Case.
ESC can now be pressed to back out of menus.
Adjusted the logic for when the breaking barrels tutorial is presented.
Reworded Easy and Medium difficulties.

notes.title: Version 0.2.8 Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
New Features

 The Merchant: This pillow will accompany Neru throughout her journey, allowing players to buy and sell items more frequently.
 Separation of EP into Red and Blue points: Equipment will now cost either Red or Blue EP to equip, depending on whether the item is offensive or defensive.
 New and Improved Level Up Flow: Stat increases from leveling will now be shown for each unit after combat.
 Saving in Combat: Players can now save and exit the game in the middle of a fight, allowing them to load back in to play it later.
 Hardcore Difficulty: Permadeath for veterans of the genre! Be wary, as once selected, this difficulty cannot be changed.

Balance

Cards

 Carrot Missile: Redesigned. Now, if the unit is on top of a carrot from Harvest, this card will always deal a critical hit.
 Star Hammer: Now scales off of both STR and INT and removes only 1 stack of Tired instead of all of them.
 Wake: Improved INT stat scaling from 60 -> 75.
 Joust: Reduced the damage bonus per tile moved from 10% -> 5%.
 Lullaby: Changed rarity from Rare -> Common. Neru now starts with 4 Lullaby instead of 2.
 Star Slam: Changed rarity from Common -> Rare. Neru now starts with 2 Star Slams instead of 4.

Equipment

 Dagger of Dusk: Now gives +3 INT, +3 DEX.
 Luna's Lunch Box: Now costs 3 Red EP instead of 4.

Status Effects

 Initiation Stance: Now gives +10% STR.
 Follow-Up Stance: Now gives +10% DEX.
 Tired: Reduced the amount of DEX and AGI lost per stack from -20% -> -10%.

Characters

 Buffed the stat growths of Neru, Luna, and Sophie.
 Increased the initial amount of Trade Points from 10 to 15.

Misc

 Save and Load Menu now defaults to the current save slot instead of always the first one.
 Sophie now comes with starting equipment: Short Sword and Life Orb.
 Stats shown in the Party Menu now represent the unit's base stats instead of their grand total, including equipment.
 Improved card targeting behavior.
 Adjusted the versioning scheme of the game.
